subject: Demo access: token collision on meeting link + reschedule
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fintechco.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: scheduling@fintechco.com
Date: Mon, 8 Apr 2029 15:12:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — we can't join (duplicate invites & SSO error)

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

We tried joining the demo you scheduled for tomorrow but the calendar shows two invitations with different join tokens and our SSO is rejecting both. The meeting link from the calendar redirect returns a token mismatch error ("join token invalid"). Our scheduling bot also shows a duplicate .ics was inserted into our shared calendar.

Can we either: 1) get a fresh invite with only one .ics / one active token, or 2) move the demo to Thursday at 10am PT? Thursday works best for all of the product team here.

I attached a screenshot from our calendar and the problematic .ics export.

Attachments: calendar-dup-screenshot.png (image/png), problematic-export.ics (text/calendar)

Thanks — sorry for the last-minute trouble.

— Amanda
Senior PM, Integrations
FinTechCo

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fintechco.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 8 Apr 2029 15:35:10 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — we can't join (duplicate invites & SSO error)

Amanda — thanks for the heads up and sorry you hit that.

Quick notes / plan:
- I see the duplicate-invite symptom sometimes when a calendar forward + organizer change occurs; it can leave an old ICS with a stale token in recipients' calendars.
- Ben, can you generate an alternate Zoom link and a single clean .ics we can send that will override the stale tokens? Please include an explicit organizer header to avoid duplicates.
- Amanda, happy to move to Thu 10:00 PT if that makes it simpler — leave the slot tentative and we'll confirm once Ben resends.

I'll hold on rescheduling until Ben confirms the new invite is live.

Date: Tue, 9 Apr 2029 09:18:45 -07:00
Subject: Alternate join + clean invite (resend)

Amanda — copied in Jonas / Marissa.

Thanks for the repro details. I generated a new meeting (Zoom) with a single active token and attached a fresh .ics. Notes:
- I set the organizer header to jonas.weber@redwood.com and set the sequence/uid to force calendar clients to replace any older invite.
- Also included an alt-join URL in a plain-text file in case your calendar strips the link: alt-zoom-link.txt (below).
- I've proactively revoked the old meeting token so the duplicate link that was cached will fail if someone clicks it. That should reduce confusion.

New meeting: Thu, Apr 11, 2029 10:00 AM PT (rescheduled as requested)
Join URL (canonical): https://zoom.us/j/9988776655?pwd=REISSUED-TOKEN

Attachments: resend-invite.ics (text/calendar), alt-zoom-link.txt (text/plain)

On Tue, Apr 9, 2029 at 9:05 AM jonas.weber@redwood.com wrote:
> Amanda — I put Thursday tentative; Ben is creating a single invite to replace the duplicates.
> 
> — Jonas

--- alt-zoom-link.txt ---

If your calendar strips tokens, please join from the canonical URL above and authenticate with your SSO.

Thanks,

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@fintechco.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, scheduling@fintechco.com
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alternate join + clean invite (resend)

Thanks — I got the new calendar item and the alt-join text; the token replaces cleanly and our SSO accepts the link now. Everyone on our side confirmed Thu 10am PT.

One small ask for future: if we need to reissue invites, could you include the canonical join URL both in the .ics and in the body (plain text) so our calendar parser doesn't lose it when it normalizes invites? That will help our shared mailbox.

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Looking forward to the demo.

— Amanda
Senior PM, Integrations
FinTechCo
